verdict.rationale: Termius is a cross-platform SSH client with mobile apps and an AI feature that turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands. Running an AI agent from a phone is a fair question for a mobile terminal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Termius analyzing pull requests or suggesting code improvements. AI command generation is an adjacent feature, and SSH-ing into a server to run a separate agent from mobile would be a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent analyze my pull requests and suggest code improvements from my phone
